content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":208,"severity":"minor","message":"The regex for stripping 'www.' was changed from {1,63} to {2,64} for the domain label length. This incorrectly requires the domain label to be at least 2 characters (was 1) and allows up to 64 characters (was 63). According to the comment and hostname RFC, each label must be 1-63 characters. This breaks www-stripping for valid single-label domains like 'www.a.example.com' and incorrectly allows 64-char labels."}]}
